text: The Patriots are riding high into Sunday's 1 PM ET matchup against the Raiders at Gillette Stadium, coming off a dramatic 29-26 Week 4 upset over the Bills at Highmark that snapped their early-season struggles and vaulted the defending AFC champions to 2-2—a stunning turnaround that's prompted plenty of premature declarations about New England's resurgence, though beat writers wisely caution against overreaction after just one win. Drake Maye's clutch performance in Buffalo, the kind that coach Mike Vrabel called critical to the team's trajectory, will be overshadowed this week by the halftime ceremony honoring Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction, a fitting tribute to the franchise's kicking legend. On the roster front, the Patriots jettisoned linebacker Jose Ramirez while making practice squad moves around the secondary, signing cornerback Al'Zillion Hamilton and releasing offensive lineman Da'Metrius Weatherspoon, suggesting continued tinkering with depth pieces. The week ahead presents a stiff defensive test against Las Vegas's formidable tight end duo of Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer, a challenge that looms much larger than Week 4's successful neutralization of Buffalo's Dalton Kincaid.
